hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the parameterized term M_t = F(x*y + t*z). Instantiating t := x gives F(x*y + x*z), which is equal to F(x*(y+z)) after expanding the argument. Instantiating t := w gives F(x*y + w*z) exactly. Thus the two summands are two specializations of the same parameterized F-term.
required_assumptions: F is a unary function, so equality of arguments implies equality of F-values
hypotheses.rationale: Both arguments share the term x*y and differ only in the coefficient of z: the first coefficient is x after expansion, the second coefficient is w. A single parameter t in the z-coefficient captures both instances.
